data.name: Fuzailoon
data.gender_notes: Fuzailoon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is gentle, kind, and generous to all. This name carries a deep spiritual meaning that encourages the bearer to be compassionate and understanding towards all beings. The name Fuzailoon carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Fuzailoon usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Fuzailoon is derived from the Arabic word Fuzail, which means kindness and gentleness. This name is deeply spiritual and carries the essence of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who was known for his compassionate and gentle nature towards all.
data.etymology: Fuzailoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fuzailoon total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: فضيلون
in_arabic.meaning: أصحاب الفضل و الزيادة في الخير و العطاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم الفضيلون مشتق من الفضل، و يعني الأشخاص الذين يتميزون بالكرم و السخاء و الزيادة في الخير و العطاء. و في القرآن الكريم، الفضل يرتبط بالرحمة و الإحسان. هذا الاسم يوحي بالعطاء و الإحسان و الفضل.

in_urdu.name: فضیلون
in_urdu.meaning: فضل والے، احسان کرنے والے، عطا کرنے والے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فضیلون نام کا مطلب ہے جو لوگ فضل کے مالک ہیں، جو احسان کرتے ہیں اور زیادہ عطا کرتے ہیں۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'فضل' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فضل، کرم اور احسان۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایت میں، یہ نام ان کی اچھائی اور سخاوت کی خصوصیات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ुज़ैलून
in_hindi.meaning: जो लोग अच्छे और अधिक देने वाले होते हैं
